system.description: A spectral beast leaps through you toward a foe within 15'. It takes the shape of whatever hunts best in the nearest wilds.

outcomes.triumph: As Success, 2x damage, and the beast drags the foe 10' toward you.
outcomes.success: The foe takes d10 damage and is knocked Prone.
outcomes.failure: Half damage, and the foe keeps its feet.
outcomes.ruin: The beast turns on its caller: you are knocked Prone. Roll on the Shadowblight table.
